# Test vector provenance

`rfc9964.json`: the six published JOSE/COSE examples in RFC 9964 Appendix A,
imported from https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9964.xml by
`tool/import_vectors.py`. The `source` field records each XML paragraph ID.
These are external expected signatures, not outputs generated by our verifier.

`webauthn.json`: deterministic integration signatures generated by
`rust/examples/generate_fixtures.rs`, using public test seeds. They sign the
actual WebAuthn authenticatorData and SHA-256(clientDataJSON) message.
They are not represented as external standard vectors.

`fixtures.dart`: generated from the JSON by `tool/embed_fixtures.py` so VM and
browser tests use identical data without network requests.

Small standard vectors are embedded in tests: GB/T 32918.2 SM2 (public key
09F9DF.../CCEA49..., message `message digest`, ID `1234567812345678`), RFC 8032
section 7.1 test 1, RFC 6979 Appendix A.2.5 `sample`, RFC 5869 Appendix A.1,
RFC 4231 case 1, and NIST SP 800-38A F.2.5.
